statement:
Getting value from AI ideation is a skill
that needs to be learned, practiced,
and refined.

AI's homogenizing effect on ideas threatens
science more than its hallucinations.

Relying on AI, especially in auditing
workflows, lowers vigilance.

Working with AI more so reinforces existing
directions of thought vs. promotes critical
thinking.

The benefits of AI-fueled increases in research
productivity outweigh the costs of a potential
narrowing of the topics researchers study.
